name: @pipeworx/mcp-dados-pt

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search datasets on dados.gov.pt, Portugal's national open data portal (Portuguese government open data). Returns matching datasets with title, description, publishing organization, and downloadable-resource counts.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Fetch a single dataset from dados.gov.pt (Portuguese government open data) by its id or slug, including full description, license, update frequency, tags, and the list of downloadable resources (files) with formats and URLs.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List or search the organizations (Portuguese government bodies and other publishers) that publish open data on dados.gov.pt, with their dataset counts and portal pages.

tools.name: recent_datasets
tools.description: Get the most recently published datasets on dados.gov.pt, Portugal's national open data portal (Portuguese government open data), sorted newest first.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dados-pt forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dados-pt pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
